static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}

static GLdouble *repl_gldouble4(GLdouble a, GLdouble b, GLdouble c, GLdouble d) {
  static GLdouble repl_gldouble4_buf[4];
  repl_gldouble4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_gldouble4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_gldouble4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_gldouble4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_gldouble4_buf;
}
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source_prologue ---
static float dd, blink, ink, ph, slit; // expanding-pulse distance; beacon blink; brightness multiplier on the base ink color; shutter-cycle phase; slit half-angle
static float dishAz; // dish azimuth, degrees -- see the note below
static float cycleLength = 30; // seconds per dome shutter cycle (open ~2/3 of it)

// concrete pad a building stands on
pad(rad) {
  glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_FAN);
    glNormal3f(0, 1, 0);
    glVertex3f(0, 0.02, 0);
    for(j, 0, 25) {
      glVertex3f(rad*cos(j*TAU/24), 0.02, rad*sin(j*TAU/24));
    }
  glEnd();
}

// cylinder wall between y0 and y1
drum(rad, y0, y1, segs) {
  // ct/st are the wall direction at this segment: the normal IS the unit
  // xz direction, and both rim vertices sit on it, so one cos/sin pair
  // feeds all three lines instead of being retaken six times.
  float th, ct, st;
  glBegin(GL_QUAD_STRIP);
    for(j, 0, segs + 1) {
      th = j*TAU/segs;
      ct = cos(th);
      st = sin(th);
      glNormal3f(ct, 0, st);
      glVertex3f(rad*ct, y1, rad*st);
      glVertex3f(rad*ct, y0, rad*st);
    }
  glEnd();
}

// snow drift: a squashed mound
drift(x, z, s) {
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(x, 0, z);
    glScalef(s*1.5, s*0.4, s);
    glutSolidSphere(1, 12, 8);
  glPopMatrix();
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -10.5000f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(13.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(-18.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -1.3500f, -0.0000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
--- source ---

  // The dish is posed twice: once in the lit opaque pass and again in the
  // unlit glow pass that hangs the feed struts and pulses off it. Both read
  // dishAz so the two frames cannot drift apart -- the same reason the
  // stencil example keeps its mask quad in a func.
  dishAz = 16*sin(0.22*t) - 12;
  // ===== Aurora observatory: a lonely dish tracking the sky =====
  // NOTE: the dome and dish are clip-plane carvings of glutSolidSphere --
  // a sphere is ONE flat command however finely tessellated, so the whole
  // station renders in a few hundred flat commands. TWO_SIDE lighting
  // (below) keeps the exposed sphere interiors lit, not black.
  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);

  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glEnable(GL_POINT_SMOOTH);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, 1);

  // ---- lit opaque pass ----
  ink = 0.55;
  glColor3f(0.92*ink, 0.95*ink, 0.98*ink);
  drift(-4.4, -1.0, 0.6);
  drift(3.7, 2.1, 0.5);
  drift(-1.1, 2.8, 0.4);
  drift(1.0, -3.2, 0.7);
  drift(-3.5, -3.1, 0.55);

  ink = 3.3;
  glColor3f(0.05*ink, 0.06*ink, 0.08*ink);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-2.4, 0, 0.3);
    pad(1.9);
  glPopMatrix();
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(1.8, 0, 0.5);
    pad(1.6);
  glPopMatrix();

  // observatory building: drum + slit dome, slit turned toward camera-east
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(1.8, 0, 0.5);
    ink = 6;
    glColor3f(0.05*ink, 0.06*ink, 0.08*ink);
    drum(1.05, 0, 1.0, 24);
    glTranslatef(0, 1, 0);
    glRotatef(-172, 0, 1, 0);
    ink = 8;
    glColor3f(0.05*ink, 0.06*ink, 0.08*ink);
    // dome = the top of a sphere: GL_CLIP_PLANE1 keeps y >= 0, and the
    // observation slit is the gap between two clipped copies of the same
    // sphere -- each draw keeps one side of a vertical plane turned `slit`
    // rad off the slit center (local -z). Clip planes only intersect
    // half-spaces, which is why cutting a slit OUT takes two draws.
    // GL_CLIP_PLANE2 keeps y <= 1.02, opening a round vent at the zenith.
    // The spheres draw rotated 90 deg so a pole sits at the zenith, where
    // the quadric's slices converge -- the vent cuts the densest mesh.
    // The planes are captured in the dome frame BEFORE that rotation, so
    // the cuts stay upright.
    // Shutter cycle: closed at t = 0, `slit` swings open over 2 s, stays
    // open (0.31 rad) until 2/3 of `cycleLength`, swings shut, and rests
    // closed for the last third. The plane equations reference `slit`, so
    // they re-evaluate every frame.
    ph = fmod(t, cycleLength);
    slit = 0.31*clamp(min(ph/2, (2*cycleLength/3 + 2 - ph)/2), 0, 1);
    glClipPlane(GL_CLIP_PLANE1, (GLdouble[]){0, 1, 0, 0});
    glEnable(GL_CLIP_PLANE1);
    glClipPlane(GL_CLIP_PLANE2, (GLdouble[]){0, -1, 0, 1.02});
    glEnable(GL_CLIP_PLANE2);
    glClipPlane(GL_CLIP_PLANE0, (GLdouble[]){cos(slit), 0, sin(slit), 0});
    glEnable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
    glPushMatrix();
      glRotatef(-90, 1, 0, 0);
      glutSolidSphere(1.05, 24, 20);
    glPopMatrix();
    glClipPlane(GL_CLIP_PLANE0, (GLdouble[]){-cos(slit), 0, sin(slit), 0});
    glPushMatrix();
      glRotatef(-90, 1, 0, 0);
      glutSolidSphere(1.05, 24, 20);
    glPopMatrix();
    glDisable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
    glDisable(GL_CLIP_PLANE1);
    glDisable(GL_CLIP_PLANE2);
  glPopMatrix();

  // radio dish: pylon, yoke, articulated bowl slowly sweeping the sky
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-2.4, 0, 0.3);
    ink = 5.2;
    glColor3f(0.05*ink, 0.06*ink, 0.08*ink);
    glPushMatrix();
      glRotatef(-90, 1, 0, 0);
      glutSolidCone(0.42, 1.3, 14, 4);
    glPopMatrix();
    glTranslatef(0, 1.3, 0);
    glutSolidSphere(0.15, 10, 8);
    glRotatef(dishAz, 0, 1, 0);
    glRotatef(-38, 1, 0, 0);
    ink = 7.5;
    glColor3f(0.05*ink, 0.06*ink, 0.08*ink);
    // faint self-glow keeps the bowl's shaded side steel-blue, not black
    glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_EMISSION, (GLfloat[]){0.06, 0.09, 0.13, 1});
    // dish = a shallow cap sliced off a big sphere: a rim of radius 1.25
    // at depth 0.38 needs R = (1.25^2 + 0.38^2)/(2*0.38) ~= 2.246. The
    // plane is captured in the dish frame (before the translate), keeping
    // y <= 0.38, so only the bowl survives -- and it tilts and sweeps with
    // the frame because the equation is re-captured every frame.
    glClipPlane(GL_CLIP_PLANE0, (GLdouble[]){0, -1, 0, 0.38});
    glEnable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(0, 2.246, 0);
      glutSolidSphere(2.246, 28, 32);
    glPopMatrix();
    glDisable(GL_CLIP_PLANE0);
    glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_EMISSION, (GLfloat[]){0, 0, 0, 1});
  glPopMatrix();

  // ---- unlit glow pass: slit light, windows, mast, beacon, dish pulses ----
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  glDepthMask(GL_FALSE);

  // warm light spilling from the dome slit; fades as the shutter closes.
  // Additive (GL_ONE) so it brightens whatever is behind the gap instead of
  // painting a flat panel over it, and a wider/dimmer halo behind the bright
  // core sells "glow" the same way the beacon's two-point halo does below.
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(1.8, 1, 0.5);
    glRotatef(-172, 0, 1, 0);
    glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
    glBegin(GL_QUADS);
      glColor4f(1.0, 0.85, 0.15, 0.35*slit/0.31);
      glVertex3f(-0.4, 0, -0.56);
      glVertex3f(0.4, 0, -0.56);
      glColor4f(1.0, 0.85, 0.15, 0.08*slit/0.31);
      glVertex3f(0.24, 0.95, -0.32);
      glVertex3f(-0.24, 0.95, -0.32);
    glEnd();
    glBegin(GL_QUADS);
      glColor4f(1.0, 0.85, 0.15, 0.60*slit/0.31);
      glVertex3f(-0.2, 0.02, -0.45);
      glVertex3f(0.2, 0.02, -0.45);
      glColor4f(1.0, 0.85, 0.15, 0.18*slit/0.31);
      glVertex3f(0.12, 0.9, -0.3);
      glVertex3f(-0.12, 0.9, -0.3);
    glEnd();
    glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  glPopMatrix();

  // two amber windows on the drum's south face
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(1.8, 0, 0.5);
    glBegin(GL_QUADS);
      glColor4f(1, 0.85, 0.15, 0.85);
      glVertex3f(-0.42, 0.38, 0.99);
      glVertex3f(-0.18, 0.38, 1.04);
      glVertex3f(-0.18, 0.62, 1.04);
      glVertex3f(-0.42, 0.62, 0.99);
      glVertex3f(0.16, 0.38, 1.04);
      glVertex3f(0.4, 0.38, 0.99);
      glVertex3f(0.4, 0.62, 0.99);
      glVertex3f(0.16, 0.62, 1.04);
    glEnd();
  glPopMatrix();

  // comms mast with guy wires, far right
  glLineWidth(2);
  glBegin(GL_LINES);
    ink = 0.65;
    glColor4f(0.92*ink, 0.95*ink, 0.98*ink, 0.9);
    glVertex3f(3.1, 0, -1.6);
    glVertex3f(3.1, 2.7, -1.6);
  glEnd();
  glLineWidth(1);
  glBegin(GL_LINES);
    glColor4f(0.92*ink, 0.95*ink, 0.98*ink, 0.4);
    glVertex3f(3.1, 2.3, -1.6);
    glVertex3f(2.1, 0, -0.9);
    glVertex3f(3.1, 2.3, -1.6);
    glVertex3f(4.1, 0, -0.9);
    glVertex3f(3.1, 2.3, -1.6);
    glVertex3f(3.1, 0, -2.9);
  glEnd();

  // blinking coral beacon: the station's one warm signal
  blink = pow(max(0, sin(1.6*t)), 6);
  glPointSize(14);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    glColor4f(1.0, 0.35, 0.20, 0.30*blink);
    glVertex3f(3.1, 2.72, -1.6);
  glEnd();
  glPointSize(5);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    glColor4f(1.0, 0.35, 0.20, 0.95*blink);
    glVertex3f(3.1, 2.72, -1.6);
  glEnd();

  // feed struts + expanding teal pulses in the dish frame (additive)
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-2.4, 1.3, 0.3);
    glRotatef(dishAz, 0, 1, 0);
    glRotatef(-38, 1, 0, 0);
    glLineWidth(1);
    glBegin(GL_LINES);
      glColor4f(0.92*ink, 0.95*ink, 0.98*ink, 0.8);
      glVertex3f(0, 0.38, 1.25);
      glVertex3f(0, 0.9, 0);
      glVertex3f(-1.0825, 0.38, -0.625);
      glVertex3f(0, 0.9, 0);
      glVertex3f(1.0825, 0.38, -0.625);
      glVertex3f(0, 0.9, 0);
    glEnd();
    glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
    // aurora light catching the dish rim
    glBegin(GL_LINE_LOOP);
      for(j, 0, 32) {
        glColor4f(0.1, 0.95, 0.85, 0.55);
        glVertex3f(1.25*cos(j*TAU/32), 0.38, 1.25*sin(j*TAU/32));
      }
    glEnd();
    glPointSize(6);
    glBegin(GL_POINTS);
      glColor4f(0.1, 0.95, 0.85, 0.9);
      glVertex3f(0, 0.9, 0);
    glEnd();
    for(i, 0, 4) {
      dd = fmod(0.8*t + i*0.6, 2.4);
      glBegin(GL_LINE_LOOP);
        for(j, 0, 32) {
          glColor4f(0.10, 0.95, 0.85, 0.5*(1 - dd/2.4));
          glVertex3f((0.5 + 0.4*dd)*cos(j*TAU/32), 0.9 + dd, (0.5 + 0.4*dd)*sin(j*TAU/32));
        }
      glEnd();
    }
  glPopMatrix();

  // leave shared GL state the way we found it
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
  glDisable(GL_BLEND);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
